metadata.title: Futaki invariant on lcK manifolds with potential
metadata.abstract: We prove that the Futaki invariant introduced by Futaki, Hattori, and Ornea vanishes identically on every compact locally conformally Kähler manifold with potential, thereby answering a question raised by Ornea and Verbitsky.
